family_title_en: Segment two-syllable words: open and closed syllables

stages.ix_title: Segment two-syllable words: open and closed syllables

prompt.en: How do you split the last word?

what_to_do.en: Tap the right open or closed split.
what_to_do.ko: 알맞은 열린 음절 또는 닫힌 음절 나누기를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: The last word of the stem is the target. Give four unique cuts of that same word. Use a hyphen, except a tier 1 miss may be the uncut word. Exactly one cut follows open and closed rules. Vary the correct slot.

roots: Four choices cut the last word of the stem. Exactly one cut is correct, and the answer slot changes from item to item.
A closed syllable ends in a consonant and has a short vowel. An open syllable ends in a vowel, including y, and has a long vowel.
Twin consonants split in the middle, as in rab-bit. One consonant between vowels splits before that consonant when the first vowel is long, and after it when the first vowel is short.
Do not split a digraph such as sh, ch, th, ck, or ng. Skip one-syllable words, words of three or more syllables, r-controlled syllables, vowel teams, and consonant-le.
Tier 1 misses are edge cuts or the uncut word. Tier 2 includes the opposite open or closed cut. Tier 3 uses the nearest cuts and does not offer the uncut word.
The target is the last word. Any other stem word is one syllable, except the <NAME> token. Stems use the roots list, allowed_extra_words, and <NAME> only.
Stay in the kid world of school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather. No brand names and no real personal names.
Choices are written syllable cuts of that same word, with a hyphen. Never use phoneme symbols, slashes, or held sounds.

tier_rules.1: One familiar word with twin consonants, such as rabbit, kitten, or ribbon. Wrong splits are at the edge or the word is left whole.
tier_rules.2: A grade-level word such as baby, hotel, or happy. One wrong split is the opposite open or closed cut, and the other wrong splits are farther.
tier_rules.3: Nearest cuts only, including the open cut set against the closed cut. The stem may be a short sentence that ends with the target word.

open_open.en: Both parts end in a vowel, so both syllables are open. The vowels are long. A final y is a vowel.
open_open.ko: 두 부분 모두 모음으로 끝나 둘 다 열린 음절입니다. 모음은 긴 소리이고, 끝의 y도 모음입니다.

open_closed.en: The first part ends in a vowel, so it is open. The second part ends in a consonant, so it is closed.
open_closed.ko: 첫 부분은 모음으로 끝나 열린 음절입니다. 둘째 부분은 자음으로 끝나 닫힌 음절입니다.

closed_open.en: The first part ends in a consonant, so it is closed. The second part ends in a vowel, so it is open. A final y is a vowel.
closed_open.ko: 첫 부분은 자음으로 끝나 닫힌 음절입니다. 둘째 부분은 모음으로 끝나 열린 음절입니다. 끝의 y도 모음입니다.

closed_closed.en: Both parts end in a consonant, so both syllables are closed. The vowels are short.
closed_closed.ko: 두 부분 모두 자음으로 끝나 둘 다 닫힌 음절입니다. 모음은 짧은 소리입니다.
